title: My Sister-in-Law Forged Mom's Policy, Left Me Penniless. So I Let Her Headset Blare Her Fraud.
description: I paid $72,000 in premiums on my mother's long-term care policy, only for my sister-in-law to forge a beneficiary change and steal the $180,000 death benefit. After finding the original policy in my mom's Bible, I proved the forgery, won back the payout plus punitive damages, and now run an advocacy group where her headset announces her fraud case number for every caller. #RevengeStory #InsuranceFraud #JusticeServed
thumb_text: SHE WEARS A HEADSET THAT ANNOUNCES HER FRAUD
pinned_comment: If your own sister-in-law forged your mom's insurance beneficiary and stole $180,000 after you'd paid $72,000 in premiums, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: PAID $72K PREMIUMS FOR 15 YEARS, UNCOVERED THE FORGED BENEFICIARY CHANGE
